value.text: Suggest one museum to visit in Madrid.

Visit the **Museo del Prado**, one of the world's great art museums. It holds masterpieces by Velázquez (*Las Meninas*), Goya, and El Greco. Plan for 2-3 hours, and check for free evening entry hours to save on tickets.
Suggest one park to visit in Madrid.

Visit **El Retiro Park**, Madrid's most iconic green space. You can rent a rowboat on the lake, see the glass Crystal Palace, and stroll the tree-lined paths. It's free to enter and a short walk from the Prado Museum.
